title: Thai Zesty Spring Pasta
description: A light and refreshing Thai-inspired pasta dish, perfect for a quick weeknight meal. The zesty lemon and lime flavors pair well with the spring vegetables.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the Croatian olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Thai chili peppers and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the spring onions and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until tender.
Stir in the zesty lemon zest and lime juice.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the vegetable mixture.
Toss to combine and season with salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
